messages:
miguel: Heads up — need to ship a small hotfix to prod for the tokenizer edge-case. Who can approve a prod deploy right now? Our policy says prod-deploy role + MFA. :warning:
lauren: I can approve but I'm on a call until 3:45pm PT. If you paste the change link I can do a quick check.
aisling: FYI only folks in `prod-deploy` or SRE leads can do final push during change window. Miguel, I don't see you in the prod-deploy group.
miguel: Huh, I deployed last week though. I ran `rbacctl whoami` but maybe token expired. How do I confirm roles?
devops-bot: Miguel: deployment request created (id: dr-1759504321). Status: pending approval. Required: 2 approvers with `prod-deploy` + MFA. To request temporary elevation run `/request-elevate miguel 2h` (audit logs will record).
miguel: /request-elevate miguel 2h — done. Sent reason: urgent-hotfix-tokenizer.
sre-oncall: Change window is 13:00-17:00 PT. We require at least one SRE lead to be an approver during that window. I can be approver. Miguel, paste the release notes + rollback steps here.
miguel: Release notes: "hotfix: handle empty-byte tokens causing OOMs in prod workers". SHA: 6a7b3f2. Rollback: revert to tag v1.4.1, disable kv-prefetch.
lauren: LGTM. Confirming MFA for elevation: I see an MFA assertion for miguel in audit log. Approving now. :thumbsup:
devops-bot: Approval recorded by lauren. MFA verification: OK. 1/2 approvers.
aisling: Approving as SRE lead. Confirmed deployable and rollback plan present.
devops-bot: Approval recorded by aisling. MFA verification: OK. 2/2 approvers reached. Starting deployment to prod (canary -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%).
devops-bot: Deploy started: canary -> 10% hosts. Logs: `2026-03-10T20:12:05Z INFO starting inference-worker`
miguel: Seeing spike in 502s on canary hosts. Dashboard: request failure rate up from 0.2% -> 3.4%.
sre-oncall: Observed increased latency as well. Paging logs.
devops-bot: Alert: Aggregate 502 rate exceeded threshold. Automatic pause at 10% canary.
miguel: I'm going to rollback. Initiating rollback now.
devops-bot: Rollback command executed by miguel. Rolling back to v1.4.1. Progress: 100% rollback complete.
lauren: Thanks for quick rollback. Please open a post-incident note with timeline and root cause hypothesis.
ops-manager: I'll schedule a role audit — we need to confirm why miguel's role was inconsistent and whether `/request-elevate` behaved as expected. Also planning a short change to the approval flow: require at least one SRE lead pre-authorized for hotfixes during change window.
aisling: To check roles locally run `rbacctl whoami --roles` and `auditlog query --user miguel --since 24h`.
miguel: Will do. Sorry for the noise — next time will file small change doc before requesting elevation.
devops-bot: Incident log appended: dr-1759504321 -> rolled back. Audit id: a-20260310-9123.
ops-manager: Action items: (1) miguel to attach postmortem; (2) infra to run role sync and verify `/request-elevate` TTL; (3) product to review whether this qualifies for an out-of-band hotfix process.
lauren: Adding a short note to release notes: "hotfix attempted and rolled back due to increased 502s on canary"
sre-oncall: I'll follow up on logs and a quick root cause check tomorrow morning. Good catch everyone. :white_check_mark:
